text: Within the matched 12000-step runs, seed 23's same-layer (layer 1) N=64 minus N=128 force gap shrank from about 0.096 at step 6000 to 0.074 at step 12000, while seed 22's cross-layer gap grew from 0.135 to 0.151. If both arms of seed 23 are trained to 24000 steps, does the gap fall below 0.04, which would mean slower convergence, or level off above it, which would mean a ceiling?
